names.en: Shocking Departure of Year Dream Wave and Dang Hun Sound

summary.text: Shocking Departure of Year Dream Wave and Dang Hun Sound is Fang Yuan's compound immortal killer move. Pink sound waves from a mini Dang Hun Mountain clear a battlefield in one sweep.

claims.text: Pressed by Star Constellation Immortal Venerable’s linked star path combat system, Fang Yuan prepares, then opens his mouth as pink light smoke gushes from his mouth and ears. The smoke gathers above his head into a mini image of Dang Hun Mountain. The mountain shakes, and crystal-collision sounds become ear-piercing pink sound waves visible to the naked eye. Wherever the waves go, star beasts freeze and crumble, stronger star beast leaders collapse, star fragments disintegrate, and surrounding star path dao marks break. The immortal killer move is named Shocking Departure of Year Dream Wave and Dang Hun Sound. One move sweeps the whole battlefield and changes the situation; Star Constellation Immortal Venerable’s expression changes.

It is a compound killer move. It uses rank eight rule path departure Gu, rank eight wisdom path great shock Gu, rank eight time path year Gu, rank seven dream armor Gu, rank eight water path huge wave Gu, and rank eight sound path ringing sound Gu, with Dang Hun Mountain as the core secluded domain of heaven and earth. Because that core is a secluded domain, the move can be comparable to a rank nine killer move, and under Fang Yuan’s dao mark amplification its might is astonishing. Star Constellation Immortal Venerable reads rule, wisdom, time, dream, water, soul, and sound paths in it, and judges dream path especially hard to block despite Dream Armor being only rank seven. The move is essentially quasi-rank nine because it contains no rank nine Immortal Gu. Its foundations include natural references such as the extinct shocking year beast, dream wave from large-scale dream realms, Dang Hun Mountain, and the extinct soul sound withered tree.
